items.title: Indonesian wildfires threaten leading orangutan research site in Borneo

sentences.en: Indonesian wildfires threaten leading orangutan research site in Borneo.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚的野火威胁着婆罗洲领先的猩猩研究基地。

sentences.en: Critically endangered Bornean orangutans flee forests as staff at Cabang Panti work round the clock to stave off blaze Wildfires in Indonesia are sweeping through a critical research site for Bornean orangutans and are now threatening a celebrated research camp, home to one of the world’s longest-running studies of wild apes.
sentences.zh: 濒临灭绝的婆罗洲猩猩逃离森林，因为Cabang Panti的工作人员全天候工作，以防止印度尼西亚的野火正在扫过婆罗洲猩猩的重要研究地点，现在正威胁着一个着名的研究营地，该营地是世界上运行时间最长的野生类人猿研究的所在地之一。

sentences.en: In the past few days, the fires have burned within 200 metres of Rangkong research station, a satellite of Cabang Panti research station, which lies about four miles north in Gunung Palung national park.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几天里，火灾发生在Rangkong研究站200米以内，这是Cabang Panti研究站的卫星，位于Gunung Palung国家公园以北约4英里处。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Russian warship fires flares at Danish helicopter as Nato jets shoot down drone over Lithuania

sentences.en: Russian warship fires flares at Danish helicopter as Nato jets shoot down drone over Lithuania.
sentences.zh: 北约喷气式飞机在立陶宛上空击落无人机时，俄罗斯军舰向丹麦直升机发射照明弹。

sentences.en: Ursula von der Leyen says incidents ‘part of broader pattern of Russian aggression and provocation against Europe’ A Russian warship fired two emergency flares at a Danish helicopter in the Baltic Sea and an Italian Nato fighter jet shot down a drone carrying an explosive device over Lithuania in what the EU described as “reckless and dangerous” Russian behaviour.
sentences.zh: 乌苏拉·冯德莱恩（ Ursula von der Leyen ）说，这些事件是俄罗斯侵略和挑衅欧洲的更广泛模式的一部分。一艘俄罗斯军舰在波罗的海向一架丹麦直升机发射了两枚紧急照明弹，一架意大利北约战斗机在立陶宛上空击落了一架携带爆炸装置的无人机，欧盟称之为“鲁莽和危险”的俄罗斯行为。

sentences.en: Poland also scrambled fighter jets “due to the activity of Russian jet-powered unmanned aerial vehicles conducting strikes on Ukrainian territory”, the day after Polish security forces retrieved a suspected Russian drone adrift in its waters.
sentences.zh: 波兰还“由于俄罗斯喷气式无人驾驶飞行器在乌克兰领土上进行罢工的活动” ，在波兰安全部队在其水域取回一架疑似俄罗斯无人机漂流后的第二天，波兰也紧急起飞了战斗机。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Explosive device found on drone shot down in Lithuania, says minister - as it happened

sentences.en: Explosive device found on drone shot down in Lithuania, says minister - as it happened.
sentences.zh: 部长说，在立陶宛被击落的无人机上发现了爆炸装置。

sentences.en: The European Commission’s president warned that recent actions in Denmark and Lithuania are ‘not isolated incidents’ Russian warship fires flares at Danish helicopter as Nato jets shoot down drone over Lithuania Ukrainian foreign minister Andrii Sybiha responded to the incident in Denmark, declaring Kyiv’s “full support” after “unacceptable actions targeting a Danish helicopter.” “ Moscow continues its attempts to destabilise Europe, not just Denmark.
sentences.zh: 欧盟委员会主席警告说，最近在丹麦和立陶宛采取的行动“不是孤立的事件” ，因为北约喷气式飞机在立陶宛上空击落无人机，乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈（ Andrii Sybiha ）对丹麦事件作出回应，宣布基辅“全力支持” “针对丹麦直升机的不可接受的行动”。“莫斯科继续试图破坏欧洲的稳定，而不仅仅是丹麦。

sentences.en: Joint and decisive action is required and Ukraine is ready to contribute to all efforts aimed at strengthening the protection of Europe from Russian threats,” he said .
sentences.zh: 需要采取联合果断行动，乌克兰准备为所有旨在加强保护欧洲免受俄罗斯威胁的努力做出贡献， ”他说。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

sentences.zh: 在周二晚上之前，意大利最繁忙的机场之一的所有航班都将暂停。

items.title: What weapon could the US have put into space?

sentences.en: What weapon could the US have put into space?.
sentences.zh: 美国能把什么武器送入太空？

sentences.zh: 美国的声明指出了地球轨道上正在发展的现代战争领域。

items.title: More than 100,000 people in Japan are now aged 100 or older

sentences.en: More than 100,000 people in Japan are now aged 100 or older.
sentences.zh: 目前，日本有超过10万人年龄在100岁或以上。

sentences.en: Figures show 88% of the centenarians are women as the population continues to age and shrink.
sentences.zh: 数据显示，随着人口持续老龄化和萎缩， 88%的百岁老人是女性。

items.title: Give every teammate and agent the right level of access to your Workers

sentences.en: Give every teammate and agent the right level of access to your Workers.
sentences.zh: 为每位团队成员和客服代表提供适当的员工访问权限级别。

sentences.en: As more teams — and now agents — build applications on Cloudflare's Developer Platform, having the right access controls is crucial to allow you to ship safely.
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多的团队（现在是代理）在Cloudflare的开发者平台上构建应用程序，拥有正确的访问控制对于让您安全出货至关重要。

sentences.en: After all, the last thing you want is for an agent to make a change in production, just because it was granted more access than it needs.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，您最不希望代理改变生产，只是因为它被授予了比它需要的更多的访问权限。

sentences.en: Now, you can give a teammate or agent access to a specific Worker, so that they can only make changes to that application and no other resources in your account.
sentences.zh: 现在，您可以为团队成员或客服代表授予特定Worker的访问权限，以便他们只能对该应用程序进行更改，而不能在您的账号中添加其他资源。

sentences.en: Moreover, we’re giving you four new roles, so you can limit exactly what they can do: The new roles are available today, for all customers.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还为您提供了四个新角色，因此您可以严格限制他们的功能：新角色现在可供所有客户使用。

sentences.en: You can assign them to a specific user, so when they log into the dashboard, they will only see the Worker you have given them access to.
sentences.zh: 您可以将他们分配给特定用户，因此当他们登录仪表板时，他们只会看到您授予他们访问权限的员工。

sentences.en: Or, you can create an API token with the scoped access, which you can give to your agent to ensure they only have access to that one application.
sentences.zh: 或者，您可以创建具有范围访问权限的API令牌，您可以将其授予代理，以确保他们只能访问该一个应用程序。

sentences.en: Here’s an example of how to create an API token with permissions per Worker: Roles designed for how teams build When defining these roles, we wanted to strike the right balance.
sentences.zh: 以下是如何创建具有每个Worker权限的API令牌的示例：专为团队构建而设计的角色在定义这些角色时，我们希望取得适当的平衡。

sentences.en: Overly broad roles force you to grant more access than intended, undermining the principle of least privilege, while providing too many individual permissions makes it difficult to know which ones to grant.
sentences.zh: 过于宽泛的角色迫使您授予比预期更多的访问权限，破坏了最小特权原则，而提供太多的个人权限会使您很难知道要授予哪些权限。

sentences.en: We landed on four roles that reflect the levels of access you may want to give a person or agent: enough to debug a resource without exposing its content, read the content without changing it, make changes without being able to delete the resource, or fully manage it.
sentences.zh: 我们确定了四个角色，这些角色反映了您可能希望授予人员或代理的访问权限级别：足以调试资源而不公开其内容，阅读内容而不更改内容，进行更改而不能够删除资源，或者完全管理资源。

sentences.en: We plan to use these same roles as we bring resource-level access controls to other Developer Platform products, including D1, R2, and KV.
sentences.zh: 我们计划使用这些相同的角色，因为我们为其他开发人员平台产品（包括D1、R2和KV ）带来了资源级别的访问控制。

sentences.en: Each role can be applied at one of three scopes.
sentences.zh: 每个角色可以应用于三个范围之一。

items.title: Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training

sentences.en: Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training.
sentences.zh: 两种方式都有：在禁止人工智能培训的同时，在搜索中保持可见性。

sentences.en: Without proper controls, website owners have long faced a difficult tradeoff: allow your content to be used for AI training, or risk losing discoverability in search.
sentences.zh: 如果没有适当的控制，网站所有者长期以来一直面临着一个艰难的权衡：允许您的内容用于人工智能培训，否则可能会失去搜索中的可发现性。

sentences.en: That tradeoff exists because some of the largest organizations on the Internet use mixed-use crawlers: a single crawler serving both search and AI training.
sentences.zh: 之所以存在这种权衡，是因为互联网上一些最大的组织使用混合用途爬虫：单个爬虫同时提供搜索和人工智能培训。

sentences.en: Refuse one, and you refuse the other.
sentences.zh: 拒绝一个，你拒绝另一个。

sentences.en: Today, Cloudflare is announcing a new Disallow AI Training setting that lets you easily stay indexed for search while refusing to let that same crawler train on your content.
sentences.zh: 今天， Cloudflare宣布推出一项新的禁止人工智能培训设置，让您轻松保持索引以进行搜索，同时拒绝让相同的爬虫对您的内容进行培训。

sentences.en: Apple, Google, and Microsoft honor or have committed (in a specified time frame) to honor this setting.
sentences.zh: Apple、Google和Microsoft尊重或已承诺（在指定时间范围内）尊重此设置。

sentences.en: Mixed-use crawlers were the hard part of the training question.
sentences.zh: 混合用途爬行器是训练问题中最难的部分。

sentences.en: AI Summaries are next.
sentences.zh: 接下来是AI摘要。

sentences.en: A site-wide yes or no is too blunt: how much of your content appears in a summary matters as much as whether it appears at all.
sentences.zh: 站点范围内的“是”或“否”太直截了当了：您的内容在摘要中的出现程度与它是否出现一样重要。

sentences.en: An opt-out for AI summaries is already one of the requirements we've set for mixed-use crawler operators.
sentences.zh: 选择退出人工智能摘要已经是我们为混合用途爬虫操作员设置的要求之一。

sentences.en: By early next year, our goal is to let you control how much of your content is included — set once on Cloudflare, rather than with each operator separately.
sentences.zh: 到明年年初，我们的目标是让您控制包含多少内容—在Cloudflare上设置一次，而不是单独设置每个运营商。

sentences.en: Why asking isn’t enough Most site owners want to be found: by humans, agents, and (good) bots.
sentences.zh: 为什么仅仅询问是不够的大多数网站所有者都希望被人、代理和（优秀的）机器人找到。

items.title: New insights from Google’s AI & Economy ATLAS

items.title: Geopolitics and grain don't mix, say these Montana farmers

sentences.en: Geopolitics and grain don't mix, say these Montana farmers.
sentences.zh: 这些蒙大拿州的农民说，地缘政治和谷物不会混在一起。

sentences.en: Farmers in states bordering Canada say they are reeling from President Trump's trade wars and resulting retaliatory tariffs.
sentences.zh: 与加拿大接壤各州的农民表示，他们正在为特朗普总统的贸易战及其报复性关税感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And it's just not neighborly.
sentences.zh: 而且这里不太邻近。

items.title: Gaza remains recovery points to possible war crimes, says UN rights chief

sentences.en: Gaza remains recovery points to possible war crimes, says UN rights chief.
sentences.zh: 联合国人权事务主管表示，加沙仍然是可能发生战争罪行的恢复点。

sentences.en: Bodies are still being pulled from the rubble of Gaza, three years after Israeli bombardment flattened entire neighbourhoods – most of them women and children.
sentences.zh: 在以色列的轰炸使整个社区夷为平地三年后，尸体仍在从加沙的废墟中被拉出，其中大多数是妇女和儿童。

items.title: World fears major war more than any other global risk, UN survey finds

sentences.en: World fears major war more than any other global risk, UN survey finds.
sentences.zh: 联合国调查发现，世界比任何其他全球风险都更担心重大战争。

sentences.en: Two years ago, the idea of a large-scale war breaking out felt like a distant hypothetical to the experts who help chart the world’s dangers.
sentences.zh: 两年前，对于帮助绘制世界危险图表的专家来说，爆发大规模战争的想法似乎是一个遥远的假设。

sentences.en: Today it tops their list of fears, according to a new UN Global Risk Report.
sentences.zh: 根据新的联合国全球风险报告，如今它已成为他们最担心的问题。

items.title: Ukraine: Attacks on education threaten an entire generation, UNICEF warns

sentences.en: Ukraine: Attacks on education threaten an entire generation, UNICEF warns.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰：联合国儿童基金会警告说，对教育的攻击威胁到整整一代人。

sentences.en: In an underground classroom in Sumy, Ukraine, children sit quietly at their desks, busy with the day’s lessons.
sentences.zh: 在乌克兰苏梅的一个地下教室里，孩子们静静地坐在办公桌前，忙着上当天的课。

sentences.en: For the moment they are shielded from the horrors of nearly five years of war, but just barely.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们几乎没有受到近五年战争的恐惧的庇护，但几乎没有。

items.title: Back to school in Haiti: ‘Madame, can you stop what the gangs are doing to us?’

sentences.en: Back to school in Haiti: ‘Madame, can you stop what the gangs are doing to us?’.
sentences.zh: 回到海地上学： “夫人，你能阻止帮派对我们所做的一切吗？”。

sentences.en: When UNICEF’s Representative in Haiti Geetanjali Narayan stepped into a classroom in Port-au-Prince at the start of the new school year, she asked the children a simple question: What did they most need from the UN children’s agency?
sentences.zh: 当联合国儿童基金会驻海地代表吉坦贾利·纳拉扬（ Geetanjali Narayan ）在新学年开始时走进太子港的一间教室时，她向孩子们提出了一个简单的问题：他们最需要联合国儿童机构提供什么？

items.title: Ebola responders grapple with widening outbreak in DR Congo

sentences.en: Ebola responders grapple with widening outbreak in DR Congo.
sentences.zh: 埃博拉应对人员正在努力应对刚果民主共和国不断扩大的疫情。

sentences.en: The deadly Ebola virus outbreak in DR Congo continues to spread across the vast country despite some success in containing it, aid officials said on Tuesday, in a renewed call for international support to help responders on the ground.
sentences.zh: 援助官员周二表示，刚果民主共和国致命的埃博拉病毒疫情继续在该国蔓延，尽管在遏制疫情方面取得了一些成功，并再次呼吁国际社会提供支持，帮助当地的救援人员。

items.title: Escalating conflict drives new displacement in Yemen

sentences.en: Escalating conflict drives new displacement in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 冲突升级导致也门出现新的流离失所现象。

sentences.en: The escalating conflict in Yemen is choking off aid shipments and driving fresh displacement, including to nearby Djibouti, with UN agencies reporting on Tuesday that nearly 100,000 people have been displaced since fighting intensified earlier this month.
sentences.zh: 也门不断升级的冲突正在扼杀援助物资的运送，并导致新的流离失所者，包括流向附近的吉布提。联合国机构周二报告称，自本月早些时候战斗加剧以来，已有近10万人流离失所。

items.title: UNICEF says thousands of children require mental health support after Nepal floods

sentences.en: UNICEF says thousands of children require mental health support after Nepal floods.
sentences.zh: 联合国儿童基金会表示，尼泊尔洪水过后，成千上万的儿童需要心理健康支持。

sentences.en: Three weeks after the devastating flash floods in Nepal, about 17,000 children require urgent mental health and psychosocial support in the country, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 联合国儿童基金会（ UNICEF ）周二表示，在尼泊尔毁灭性的山洪爆发三周后，该国约有17,000名儿童需要紧急的心理健康和社会心理支持。

items.title: Security Council LIVE: Rising violence triggers emergency meeting on Yemen

sentences.en: Security Council LIVE: Rising violence triggers emergency meeting on Yemen.
sentences.zh: 安理会现场直播：暴力升级引发了也门问题紧急会议。

sentences.en: Amid rising violence in Yemen, the Security Council met in emergency session on Tuesday to discuss the situation surrounding the critical Bab el-Mandeb Strait shipping route as UN agencies warn of rising displacement, including thousands of Yemenis fleeing to Djibouti.
sentences.zh: 在也门暴力事件不断增加的情况下，安理会周二召开紧急会议，讨论关键的巴布·曼德布海峡航线周围的局势，因为联合国机构警告流离失所者人数增加，其中包括数千名逃往吉布提的也门人。

sentences.en: UN News app users can follow here.
sentences.zh: 联合国新闻应用程序用户可以在此处关注。

items.title: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter

sentences.en: Denmark says Russian warship fired flares at military helicopter.
sentences.zh: 丹麦说，俄罗斯军舰向军用直升机发射了照明弹。

sentences.en: The Danish prime minister has accused Russia of "reckless" behaviour, while the Kremlin is yet to comment.
sentences.zh: 丹麦首相指责俄罗斯“鲁莽”行为，而克里姆林宫尚未发表评论。

items.title: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace

sentences.en: Nato jets down drone that entered Lithuanian airspace.
sentences.zh: 北约击落进入立陶宛领空的无人机。

sentences.en: The origin of the drone is currently unknown, but authorities say it likely entered Lithuania from neighbouring Belarus, an ally of Russia.
sentences.zh: 这架无人机的起源目前尚不清楚，但当局表示，它可能是从俄罗斯的盟友邻国白俄罗斯进入立陶宛的。

items.title: ‘I believed the hype’: the white South Africans denied refugee status in the US

sentences.en: ‘I believed the hype’: the white South Africans denied refugee status in the US.
sentences.zh: “我相信炒作” ：南非白人拒绝在美国获得难民身份。

sentences.en: Drive to save thousands of Afrikaners from false claims of ‘white genocide’ appears to show signs of slowing When Donald Trump announced in February 2025 that the US would accept Afrikaners from South Africa as refugees, many white South Africans who believed that they were victims of racism in their country thought that their prayers had been answered.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）于2025年2月宣布，美国将接受来自南非的非洲裔美国人作为难民，许多认为自己是自己国家种族主义受害者的南非白人认为他们的祈祷得到了回应。

sentences.en: However, in the past few months, dozens of applicants to the refugee programme have been rejected, with many left dismayed and confused as to why they would be left to face what Trump has falsely claimed is a “white genocide” in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 然而，在过去几个月中，数十名难民计划申请人被拒绝，许多人感到沮丧和困惑，不知道为什么他们会被迫面对特朗普虚假声称的南非“白人种族灭绝”。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Ebola outbreak in DRC has peaked, say authorities, as infection rates slow

sentences.en: Ebola outbreak in DRC has peaked, say authorities, as infection rates slow.
sentences.zh: 当局表示，随着感染率放缓，刚果民主共和国的埃博拉疫情已经达到顶峰。

sentences.en: Almost 3,500 people have died in outbreak and experts say more must be done to ensure Bundibugyo is under control Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have announced that the Ebola outbreak ravaging parts of the country has reached its peak.
sentences.zh: 近3500人死于埃博拉疫情，专家表示，必须采取更多措施确保Bundibugyo受到控制。刚果民主共和国当局宣布，肆虐该国部分地区的埃博拉疫情已达到顶峰。

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Memory QoS Graduates to Beta

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: Memory QoS Graduates to Beta.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes v 1.37 ：内存QoS毕业测试版。

sentences.en: Memory QoS has graduated to Beta in Kubernetes v1.37 and is now enabled by default.
sentences.zh: 内存QoS已升级到Kubernetes v 1.37的Beta版，现在已默认启用。

sentences.en: On Linux nodes running cgroup v2, the feature uses the memory controller to give the kernel better guidance on how to treat container memory.
sentences.zh: 在运行cgroup v2的Linux节点上，该功能使用内存控制器来更好地指导内核如何处理容器内存。

sentences.en: It was first introduced as Alpha in v1.22, and expanded in v1.36 with tiered memory reservation.
sentences.zh: 它最初在v 1.22中作为Alpha引入，并在v 1.36中通过分层内存保留进行了扩展。

sentences.en: This post covers what changed in v1.37, what the Beta promotion means for cluster operators, and how to configure the feature.
sentences.zh: 本文介绍了v 1.37中的更改、Beta升级对集群运营商的含义以及如何配置该功能。

sentences.en: What changed in v1.37 Memory QoS is Beta and enabled by default The MemoryQoS feature gate is now Beta in v1.37.
sentences.zh: V 1.37内存QoS中的变化是测试版，默认情况下启用MemoryQoS功能门户现在是v 1.37中的测试版。

sentences.en: This means every v1.37 kubelet has the feature gate turned on without any configuration change.
sentences.zh: 这意味着每个v 1.37 kubelet都开启了功能门，而无需任何配置更改。

sentences.en: Turning on the feature by default is safe because the default kubelet configuration does not enable memory throttling or memory reservation.
No memory.high , memory.min , or memory.low values are written to cgroups unless you explicitly configure them.
You can opt into specific behaviors through kubelet configuration fields: Set memoryThrottlingFactor (for example, 0.9 ) to enable memory.high throttling on Burstable and BestEffort containers.
The default is null , which means no throttling.
Set memoryReservationPolicy to TieredReservation to enable tiered memory protection via memory.min and memory.low .

items.title: Kubernetes Changed Block Tracking API - Beta Differences

sentences.en: Kubernetes Changed Block Tracking API - Beta Differences.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes更改了块跟踪API -测试版差异。

sentences.en: Changed Block Tracking (CBT) support for CSI drivers shipped as Alpha in September 2025.
sentences.zh: 已更改2025年9月以Alpha身份发货的CSI驱动程序的块跟踪(CBT)支持。

sentences.en: With the March 2026 v1.0.0 release of the external-snapshot-metadata project, the feature moved to Beta .
sentences.zh: 随着2026年3月v1.0.0外部快照元数据项目的发布，该功能已移至测试版。

sentences.en: If you aren't yet familiar with changed block tracking for storage in Kubernetes, the Alpha announcement covers the motivation, the three primary components (the CSI SnapshotMetadata gRPC service, the SnapshotMetadataService CRD, and the external-snapshot-metadata sidecar), and a walkthrough of how to use the API.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不熟悉Kubernetes中存储的更改块跟踪， Alpha公告涵盖了动机、三个主要组件（ CSI SnapshotMetadata gRPC服务、SnapshotMetadataService CRD和external-snapshot-metadata sidecar ）以及如何使用API的演练。

sentences.en: CBT currently applies to block volumes; file-volume and network file-share changed-list tracking is not covered by this feature.
sentences.zh: CBT当前适用于块卷；此功能不涵盖文件卷和网络文件共享更改列表跟踪。

sentences.en: This post focuses on what is different in Beta.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章重点介绍了测试版的不同之处。

sentences.en: What's new in Beta The main change in that release was the promotion of the SnapshotMetadataService CRD from v1alpha1 to v1beta1 .
sentences.zh: 测试版中的新增功能该版本的主要变化是将SnapshotMetadataService CRD从v1alpha1升级到v1beta1。

sentences.en: The CRD used to advertise a driver's metadata service now serves cbt.storage.k8s.io/v1beta1 .
sentences.zh: 用于宣传司机元数据服务的CRD现在服务于cbt.storage.k8s.io/v1beta1。

sentences.en: The schema itself is unchanged, but this release removed v1alpha1 (rather than serving it alongside the new version).
sentences.zh: 架构本身不变，但此版本删除了v1alpha1 （而不是与新版本一起提供）。

sentences.en: If you are upgrading from Alpha, you need to: Re-apply the CRD definition shipped with v1.0.0 .
sentences.zh: 如果您从Alpha升级，则需要：重新应用v1.0.0附带的CRD定义。

sentences.en: Update SnapshotMetadataService manifests to use apiVersion: cbt.storage.k8s.io/v1beta1 .
sentences.zh: 更新SnapshotMetadataService清单以使用apiVersion ： cbt.storage.k8s.io/v1beta1。

sentences.en: Update any client or controller code that talks to the CRD.
sentences.zh: 更新与CRD交谈的任何客户端或控制器代码。

items.title: ‘A coin flip’: on the campaign trail as Brazil’s far right edges back to power

sentences.en: ‘A coin flip’: on the campaign trail as Brazil’s far right edges back to power.
sentences.zh: “抛硬币” ：在巴西极右翼重新掌权的竞选活动中。

sentences.en: Neck-and-neck with Lula in polls, Flávio Bolsonaro fires up his base in the bellwether state of Minas Gerais – starting at the scene of his father’s stabbing A giant banner of Brazil’s incarcerated former president Jair Bolsonaro fluttered in the morning breeze as his eldest son, Flávio, touched down at an airfield on the fringe of a city that will soon help decide the future of one of the biggest democracies on earth.
sentences.zh: 弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）在民意调查中与卢拉（ Lula ）并肩作战，从他父亲刺伤米纳斯吉拉斯州（ Minas Gerais ）的场景开始。当他的长子弗拉维奥（ Flávio ）降落在一个城市边缘的机场时，巴西被监禁的前总统贾尔·博尔索纳罗（ Jair Bolsonaro ）的巨大旗帜在晨风中飘扬，该机场很快将帮助决定地球上最大的民主国家之一的未来。

sentences.en: “Brazil is rudderless.
sentences.zh: “巴西没有舵。

sentences.en: Brazil has no president and Brazil needs a president – and that president is Flávio Bolsonaro,” the far-right senator declared as he waded into the flock of supporters who had gathered to welcome him to Juiz de Fora, one of the largest cities in the battleground state of Minas Gerais.
sentences.zh: 巴西没有总统，巴西需要一位总统--这位总统是弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）。”这位极右翼参议员在一群支持者聚集在一起，欢迎他来到Juiz de Fora ，这是战场州米纳斯吉拉斯州最大的城市之一。
